answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M61.1 derived goal text from Brownie-specific wording plus the completed transition label, ignoring ProductContinuationProvenance.remaining_capability.

answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M61.1 admission plumbing and M60 recovery because this changes objective semantics and replay identity, not route shape or reporting.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. Existing headless.run.advance/drive derived product-continuation target and headless.continue_once admission behavior are corrected; no JSON-RPC method is added.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It extends typed bounded provenance on existing TaskRecord and TaskStarted evidence, not a report, digest, history, readiness, preview, inspection, or dashboard surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Rust now generates runtime-derived objective goals from bounded remaining_capability and includes remaining-capability identity in the derived objective fingerprint.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Headless automation can progress from a product decision to the actual unfinished objective rather than reusing completed transition labels or caller-authored text.
answers.milestone_progress: Repairs M61.1 so later M61 journey binding can safely build on generic remaining-capability-bound objective provenance.

safety_boundary: Source decision must remain current continue_development with plan_next_phase and matching fingerprints.
Runtime-derived objective admission requires bounded non-empty remaining_capability.
Generated goal uses bounded remaining-capability metadata and fingerprints only.
Admission creates a Created task only; it does not automatically run provider, tools, shell, git, network, services, or workspace mutation.
Ledger and RPC output avoid raw prompts, provider responses, file content, diffs, command output, paths, credentials, and secrets.
non_goals: No new report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, preview, inspection, dashboard, or summary wrapper.
No automatic journey execution or task.run beyond existing explicit drive budget behavior.
No replacement of caller-supplied product-continuation admission paths.
rejected_alternatives: Rejected keeping the M61.1 Brownie-specific template because it is not valid for arbitrary repositories.
Rejected deriving the next objective from the completed concrete transition because that can repeat already-finished work.
Rejected adding a planning/readiness report because it would not change runtime objective derivation.
Rejected combining this phase with full objective journey binding because that would mix correction and execution semantics.
